items.html: And these nine, from Keter to Yesod, which are below this RDL"A, are those that it called in these places nine halls that are not spirits and are not souls. Also these nine were mentioned in the Idra, page 288, side A: "Rabbi Shimon opened and said, 'I am to my beloved and his desire is upon me,' etc., 'the Ancient of all ancients, the concealed of all concealments, was adorned and not adorned, etc.; when He was adorned, He brought out nine flaming lights from His adornments, and those lights spread to every side, like a lamp from which lights spread to every side,' etc.
